honor.Description_lang: Honor is gained by killing members of the opposite faction in PvP combat. You can use honor points to purchase special items.

rankPoints.Description_lang: Rank points are gained by completing tasks given in Gadgetzan or participating in battlegrounds. Rank points increase your PvP Rank which grants you access to purchase special items.

progressionStrings.TagText_lang: Each week, the Rank Points cap is increased, up to a maximum of |cnHIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR:%d|r for |cnHIGHLIGHT_FONT_COLOR:Rank %d|r.

battlegrounds.name: Alterac Valley
battlegrounds.description: Hidden within the Alterac Mountains, Alterac Valley is the home of Thrall's own clan of orcs, the Frostwolves. The Stormpike dwarves have established a foothold in the valley and seek to plumb its depths for riches, and links to their ancestral past. The territorial Frostwolves, unwilling to suffer the dwarven incursion, have rallied an army... an army eager for righteous slaughter.

battlegrounds.name: Warsong Gulch
battlegrounds.description: A valley bordering Ashenvale Forest and the Barrens, Warsong Gulch hosts a constant battle between the Horde and the Alliance. Orcs use their Warsong Mill to cut lumber reaped from Ashenvale, provoking the night elves of Silverwing Hold. Eager to aid their allies, members of every race in Azeroth rush to the Gulch to lend sword, or spell, to the conflict.

battlegrounds.name: Arathi Basin
battlegrounds.description: The Arathi Basin is one of the main staging points of war between the Humans and the Forsaken in Azeroth. The League of Arathor seek to reclaim lost lands for their benefactors in Stormwind, while the Defilers – elite troopers under the watchful eye of Varimathras – seek to sever the vital connection between the Humans and their Dwarven allies to the south.

battlegrounds.name: Darkspear Islands
battlegrounds.description: Off the coast of Kalimdor is the storm-torn islands of the Darkspear tribe.  These islands are coveted by the trolls for their spiritual significance - but the encroaching Alliance seek to gain a foothold off the coast of Durotar.

darkspearObjectives:
- Capture and hold objectives
- Capture the Darkspear relic
- Earn 1500 resources

darkspearFactions.name: Darkspear Raiders
darkspearFactions.description: Loyal to the troll nation, the Darkspear Raiders battle the Theramore Expeditionary Force for control of their ancestral Darkspear Islands.

darkspearFactions.name: Theramore Expeditionary Force
darkspearFactions.description: Loyal partisans for their city, the Theramore Expeditionary Force battles the Darkspear Raiders for control of the so-called Darkspear Islands.
